## Current role

Machine Learning Intern, Techkey Technology Pvt. Ltd., Kathmandu — August 2026 to
present. Builds and trains models in Python with Scikit-learn, TensorFlow and
PyTorch, covering data preprocessing, feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning
and evaluation on accuracy, precision and recall. Researches and prototypes
candidate approaches, benchmarks every model against a baseline, documents
datasets and experiment results for reproducibility, and refactors research
prototypes into modular Python reviewed by senior engineers.

## Projects

- **AgniDrishti Nepal** (2026, final year major project) — AI wildfire prediction
  and early warning system for Nepal. Custom-trained Random Forest and Naive Bayes
  models score wildfire risk from weather, elevation and satellite fire-hotspot
  data, with Vapour Pressure Deficit as an engineered feature. JWT-secured FastAPI
  backend with role-based access, public alerting and automated full-country risk
  scans; React front end with real-time hotspot mapping. Data from NASA FIRMS,
  OpenWeatherMap and Open-Elevation.
- **QR-Based Digital Academic System** (2026, winner of TechSprint Hackathon 2026)
  — replaced paper lab submissions at Tribhuvan University. Per-student QR codes
  for instant record access, batch scanning for evaluators, and three role-based
  portals with real-time notifications. React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js.
  201+ team commits.
- **SnapSpend** (2025) — financial statement analyzer that extracts, categorizes
  and visualizes transactions from bank statement images and PDFs. Tesseract OCR
  and PyMuPDF for dual-mode extraction, rule-based categorization, Chart.js
  dashboards. Python, Flask, Pandas.
- **Project Ecolog** (2024, winner of Tech Conclave 2024 and technical category
  winner at BPC Hackfest 2024) — Raspberry Pi forest fire and intrusion detection
  pairing real-time audio classification for gunshots and smoke with Azure Custom
  Vision imaging. Azure Blob Storage archives frames; the system triggers hardware
  alerts and streams live data to a web dashboard. Built by a four-person team.
